claims.assertion: Arishah describes the Urmah as strong and independent, engaging the Galactic Federation mainly through diplomacy and rejecting its control over their actions.
claims.speaker: Arishah
claims.qualifiers: He says the Urmah respond forcefully when their friends or interests are threatened.

claims.assertion: Arishah says the Urmah suspect Federation concealment about Earth but will not intervene until they understand the situation or uncover a further agenda.
claims.speaker: Arishah
claims.qualifiers: He says the Federation’s claim that Earth’s inhabitants chose the experience is a restraint on intervention.

coverage_gaps: Urmah ethical limits and military posture
